plugin_desc: SNMP monitoring template for Baicells LTE CPE devices (BAICELLS-MIB). It reports uptime, memory total/free/used and utilization, and interface traffic (enterprise PEN 53058).
name: Wireless

metrics.name: device_memory_usage
metrics.description: Memory utilization of the Baicells CPE derived as (MemoryTotal - MemoryFree) / MemoryTotal (BAICELLS-MIB scalars 1.3.6.1.4.1.53058.2.1.11.0 / .12.0). Both values are DisplayString and are parsed at collection.

metrics.name: device_memory_total
metrics.description: Total memory of the Baicells CPE in bytes (BAICELLS-MIB MemoryTotal, scalar 1.3.6.1.4.1.53058.2.1.11.0). Text with a size unit such as "249856 kB" is converted to bytes; values without a unit only contribute to utilization.

metrics.name: device_memory_free
metrics.description: Free memory of the Baicells CPE in bytes (BAICELLS-MIB MemoryFree, scalar 1.3.6.1.4.1.53058.2.1.12.0), parsed from DisplayString with its size unit.

metrics.name: device_memory_used
metrics.description: Used memory of the Baicells CPE in bytes, derived as MemoryTotal minus MemoryFree.

metrics.name: interface_ifHCInOctets
metrics.description: Average inbound interface bytes per second over five minutes from the 64-bit IF-MIB ifHCInOctets counter.

metrics.name: interface_ifHCOutOctets
metrics.description: Average outbound interface bytes per second over five minutes from the 64-bit IF-MIB ifHCOutOctets counter.

metrics.name: device_total_incoming_traffic
metrics.description: Total inbound interface bytes per second over five minutes, summed from 64-bit ifHCInOctets.

metrics.name: device_total_outgoing_traffic
metrics.description: Total outbound interface bytes per second over five minutes, summed from 64-bit ifHCOutOctets.

metrics.name: snmp_uptime
metrics.description: This metric indicates the uptime of the device since the last restart. By monitoring the uptime, network administrators can understand the stability and reliability of the device and identify potential reboot or failure issues.
